headline: Approved $1.4 million for Main Street traffic signal upgrades and on-call water excavation contracts through 2031.
summary: Town Meeting TV asked the city for a 5% increase, a total of $109,967. Residents asked about the Winooski Valley Parks District audit and how disruptive the Main Street work will be.
decisions: Approved establishing the $1.4 million project budget for Main Street signal upgrades, unanimously.
Approved on-call water excavation contracts through 2031 with three contractors, up to $500,000 each, unanimously.
discussion: Town Meeting TV funding: Members said cable revenue is falling and discussed other sources, such as an amusements tax and a federal broadband rule that could limit franchise fees.
Winooski Valley Parks District audit: A resident asked when the next audit will happen and pointed to a possible typo in the picnic shelter rates in the report.
Main Street signal timing: Members asked about traffic disruption during the work and whether left-turn lanes could be added. Staff said the upgrade would allow left-turn phasing.
Noon bus service: A speaker asked the city to find money to restore the noon bus between Burlington and Montpelier.
Broadband franchise fees: Members flagged a federal broadband proposal that could remove cities' right to set franchise fees and asked the city to track it.
